rationale: The batch establishes a new, program-scale agenda: exact classification and nonrealizability analysis for three-edge star perturbations of Ehlich block Gram matrices. No existing program covers this structural/computational Gram-family classification, so root may need a new top-level program and an updated program listing. The global certified interval and all existing arithmetic-divisibility and witness-certification conclusions remain unchanged, so their existing nodes do not require updates.
